hero.headline: Where Khayelitsha’s children come to learn, play & grow.
hero.intro: A safe place for early learning, afterschool care, youth and culture — built by this community, for this community.

campaignCard.intro: Right now our 15 little ones sit on the floor. Help us furnish a proper learning space — every rand is photographed and accounted for.
campaignCard.rightHeading: Give a child a place to learn
campaignCard.note: 100% of campaign funds go directly to furniture and safety equipment. We post photos and invoices of every purchase.

programmes.heading: Seven ways we show up for our community
programmes.subtext: From a child’s very first years to a young adult’s first job — we meet families where they are.

story.heading: Opening minds, one child at a time
story.body: “Sivulingqondo” means *we open the mind*. We started with a few children and a simple belief — that every child deserves dignity, every young person deserves opportunity, and every community deserves to keep its heritage alive.
story.quote: When a child feels safe and seen, they can learn anything. That’s the foundation we’re building here.

transparency.heading: Our work, out in the open
transparency.intro: We show up every week — and we show the work. Moments from our mobile soup kitchen and programmes in Khayelitsha. Every campaign purchase comes with a photo and an invoice, too.

involve.heading: There’s a place for you here
involve.intro: Give once, give monthly, volunteer your time, or partner with us. Every bit helps a child in Khayelitsha thrive.
